scope: Exercise the real shared border style/width/color Inspector routes through Canvas, draft Save, Editor reload and explicit Publish for every editable non-root PARTIAL type; fix the Divider public-render precedence defect found by the lifecycle test.

initial_regression.result: FAIL; the new type matrix reached explicit public Publish and exposed the Divider renderer overriding the shared responsive borderColor with its decoration-profile default.

fix.change: Keep the versioned decoration border as Divider defaults, then emit shared responsive styles last so Inspector-authored border width, style and color take precedence, matching Canvas behavior.

coverage: all 44 editable non-root PARTIAL types expose border.style/border.width/border.color through responsive.set with borderStyle/borderWidth/borderColor Page Model keys

all three border controls survive Editor reload and retain their values
explicit Publish applies each border to the public renderer with the exact expected computed width, style and color
the Divider public renderer now preserves shared responsive border overrides over its specialized decoration defaults
